items.title: Clark Terry interviewed by Joe Williams and Michael Woods, Clinton, New York, May 19, 1995
items.q: the drummer we had, David Adams, was a Caucasian drummer. He was the only Caucasian in the whole group.

ctx.x: And who was the kid that you had out of Westwood, on drums?

Adams, yeah. Here we were in Africa and I was in charge, and I went up to the microphone and asked if Mr. Adams would come up and please play with the Africans. Only in Africa. They couldn’t find their drummer.
